company_description:
Ultra Clean Systems, Inc., is a US manufacturer of medical grade ultrasonic cleaning systems designed specifically for cleaning surgical instruments.

Headquartered in Oldsmar, Florida, Ultra Clean Systems offers a variety unique ultrasonic cleaning systems appropriate for all sizes of hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and budgets.

Our ultrasonic cleaning systems are known for their fast, yet ultra-thorough, 13-minute standard instrument or 15-minute robotic instrument wash cycles and high instrument capacity. Ultra Clean is proud to be an industry leader in this highly specialized field of surgical instrument processing.

Ultra Clean Systems, Inc., is true to its name with our titanium rod transducer (TRT) surgical instrument cleaning systems. Each machine provides the ultimate in speed and thoroughness in a process that is independently validated to clean robotic instruments.

Combined with an array of best-in-class cleaning systems is our UCS line of affiliated consumable products, such as brushes, antifatigue mats, and PPE gear. Together Ultra Clean Systems and UCS fill all the needs of any sterile processing department.

Ultra Clean Systems was founded by O'Brien Cale in 1999. Utilizing his nearly 20 years of industry experience, O' Brien developed a range of products that are the envy of the industry. With his vision and deep understanding of customer needs, O' Brien has guided Ultra Clean Systems to become an industry innovator and leader in ultrasonic cleaning systems.
